text:
ana: Quick sync — BlueRibbon is evaluating a swap from CompetitorX to Redwood. They want a POC showing a compat adapter, a pricing delta/TCO, and completed security questionnaire. Can SE + Sec + Sales split ownership?

mike: I can run SE. Quick Q: do they need function-calling parity or just standard generate/chat endpoints? Also what qps/seq lengths are we targeting?

ana: They asked for both: function-calling for our chat flow + single-turn generate. Traffic: ~30 qps sustained, spikes to ~200. Typical context ~2k-3k tokens.

jess: Pricing ask: they want hosted vs dedicated pricing comparisons, plus an enterprise commit option. Procurement timeline is ~60 days. Need any legal pre-reqs?

oliver: For the adapter there are two pragmatic paths: 1) thin proxy that rewrites requests to Redwood's API (fast to implement) 2) normalization shim that also adjusts tokenization, stop-seq behavior, and function-calling wiring (better parity). Expect ~5-10% behavioral deltas on sampling-heavy prompts unless we normalize.

oliver: Example smoke curl (will adapt): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/compat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"compat-x","input":"Summarize the conversation"}'
```

jordan: Security checklist from BlueRibbon: SAML SSO, per-tenant KMS/HSM, audit log exports (12 months), IP allowlist, and formal answers to their vendor questionnaire. We have SOC2 + ISO27001. Need to confirm KMS options for Private + Dedicated.

mike: Action items: (1) SE to run compat eval + smoke prompts (2) Sec to prepare questionnaire + architecture diagram (3) Sales to draft pricing delta and TCO. Who will own the canonical prompt set?

ana: I'll own collecting the prompt set from BlueRibbon (they'll share canonical bundle). Also confirm: data retention defaults? They asked for 90d logs with exports to 12mo.

jordan: Hosted default retention is 30d. Dedicated/Private can be configured for 90d and export to 12mo. I'll document exact contract language & options.

jess: I'll draft a pricing sheet. Suggestion: offer migration credits — maybe 3 months discounted Dedicated or a one-time onboarding credit. Procurement likes concrete dollar delta vs CompetitorX.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll spin up the compatibility harness this afternoon and run the first pass. Need sample API keys and the prompt bundle.

ana: @mike dropping keys and prompt bundle into 1Password now. Also sharing security contact at BlueRibbon: sec@blueribbon.com

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: compat-eval-env -> staging at 2023-09-12T16:00Z :white_check_mark:

oliver: Note — enabling prefix/KV caching in the adapter typically reduces token usage ~12% for convo workloads like theirs. Include that in the TCO.

jess: Target: deliver POC results, security packet, and draft contract by 2023-09-22. Feasible?

mike: Yes — with SE + Eng support. Will post initial smoke results by EOD tomorrow.

ana: Thanks all — will monitor. Ping me if anything blocks. :pray:
